name: Autumn
subtitle: every Autumn's planet
story: On Autumn, the leaves aren't the only thing that falls. People here physically fall in love: catch the right eye and down you go, in public, usually with shopping. Cafés have soft floors, and weddings have a nurse on standby. Jake had been getting the same train as Liam for three months before either of them looked up. When he did, he went down in the aisle. Liam went to help, and went down too. It was mutual.
hook: A planet for everyone who knew straight away.

beats.text:
You see the one,
and down you go.

Cafés have soft floors.
Weddings have a nurse.

Jake fell hard for Liam
on the train.

In front of everyone.
With his shopping.

beats.note: identical camera to Jake's fall; Liam goes down too. Turn line

episode.caption:
Jake and Liam haven't met yet.

Autumn: 3.9 million people, a 26-hour day, one moon, and the leaves aren't the only thing that falls. People here physically fall in love. Catch the right eye and down you go, in public, usually holding shopping. Cafés have soft floors. Weddings have a nurse on standby. Jake had been getting the same train as Liam for three months before either of them looked up.

I was introduced to a very handsome fisherman. I'd like to say I stayed on my feet.

(The story goes that 'fall' for autumn comes from 'the fall of the leaf', back in the 1500s. On Autumn, the leaves are the least of it.)

Where were you when you fell for yours?

first_comment: They still get the same train. They make sure they've got a seat.
